allowed-help: One IPv4 or IPv6 address or range per line, such as 203.0.113.7 or 198.51.100.0/24. Up to {{max}}. Leave empty to allow any address.
error-invalid: Line {{line}}: {{value}} is not an IPv4 or IPv6 address or range. Hostnames and wildcards are not accepted.
error-limit-whole: Enter a whole number, or leave it blank.
error-open-range: Line {{line}}: a range covering every address is not a restriction. Leave the list empty to allow any address.
error-prefix: Line {{line}}: the prefix length must be between /{{min}} and /{{max}}.
error-too-many: Line {{line}}: at most {{max}} addresses are allowed.
limit-help: Blank uses your plan limit of {{max}} a minute. A lower number applies to this key only.
refused_one: Refused requests: {{count}} in the last 7 days
refused_other: Refused requests: {{count}} in the last 7 days
refused-with-address_one: Refused requests: {{count}} in the last 7 days, last from {{address}}
refused-with-address_other: Refused requests: {{count}} in the last 7 days, last from {{address}}
